channel.title: Knowledge Recorder Updates
channel.description: Signed macOS updates for Knowledge Recorder.

item.description:
## macOS
- Restored dragging the floating mini-player on macOS 27 Golden Gate. Move it by the timer, audio wave or an empty background area, including while another app is active. - Fixed the top-left mode icon shifting after its menu closes. - Added an accessible name and current-mode value to the mode selector.
Requires macOS 15 or later on Apple Silicon. This is a macOS-only update; Windows is unchanged.

## macOS
- Adds a restrained, consistent motion language for page and menu changes, hover and press feedback, status messages, viewers, editors, and processing indicators. - Fully respects macOS Reduce Motion: custom spatial movement and continuous pulses become static or opacity-only. - Keeps drawing, dragging, resizing, cropping, and other direct interactions immediate.
SHA256:
- `DesktopRecorder-macOS.dmg`: `4b258d7fda418d289c2c7f70616000cb0331f04f9e1141566e48eb6bec1a6f1f`

## macOS
- Keeps the dictation pill visible when switching between macOS desktops, displays, and another app's full-screen space. - Preserves the foreground app and paste target while bringing the pill back to the front.
SHA256:
`7ebb62c281898e019ffc43266f60a8aabd219aaec82e840dcb654d669ddf7393 DesktopRecorder-macOS.dmg`
